name: Kuikuro dark-earth soil management
description: Kuikuro people in the Upper Xingu intentionally enrich soil as part of a living agricultural landscape.

date.basis: Date refers to this scoped event or archaeological context, not to a global origin.

events.statement: Kuikuro people in the Upper Xingu intentionally enrich soil as part of a living agricultural landscape.

evidence.supports: The researchers, including Kuikuro authors, describe intentional soil enrichment observed in a present-day Kuikuro village and compare it with ancient dark-earth sites. Similarities are interpreted as evidence for past management, but do not directly date the beginning of the modern community practice or prove all ancient soils had the same origin.

events.caveats: The year dates a research publication documenting living practice, not its beginning. Similar archaeological soil patterns support an interpretation of earlier management, but do not establish identical practices or continuous transmission at every site.
